claims.text: DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio Sep 30, 2026 (day-only; NOT Oct 1): family of watermarking methods for synthetic biology (protein sequences + predicted 3D structures), extending SynthID to bio.
claims.context: DeepMind blog Sep 30, full body read; Nature paper same date; X Oct 1 11:43Z is circulation.

claims.text: Sequence = amino-acid choice guidance (ProteinMPNN + SynthID-text tournament sampling + AF3/wm filtering); structure = fine-tuned AlphaFold 3 diffusion part, watermark in weights; verifiable on synthesized physical protein.
claims.context: Vendor method description; full protocol in Nature paper.

claims.text: Watermarked binders (AlphaProteo + SynthID-ProteinMPNN) matched hit rate, KD affinity, natural diversity of unwatermarked across VEGF-A/SC2-RBD/PD-L1; first watermarked functional binders claimed; structure preserves AF3 accuracy with near-perfect detectability.
claims.context: Vendor-reported lab tests, NOT general biological neutrality.

claims.text: Nature paper Sep 30 open access; Evo 2 phage genome work with Hie lab/Arc ongoing; code + in vitro data + weights released; biosecurity/database layer, tamper-robustness future work.

limitations.text: Function preservation bounded to tested binders/targets; do not generalize.
